note: profile.* → businesses.profile; inputs.<step>.* → businesses.inputs. checks = array of option strings; date = YYYY-MM-DD.

sells.label: What you sell
sells.placeholder: Products or services, in a sentence or two

customers.label: Who buys from you today
customers.placeholder: e.g. Women 30–55 buying gifts, local offices ordering client gifts

proof.label: Reviews, awards or numbers you’re proud of

hoursWeek.label: Hours you work in the business each week
hoursWeek.how: Count a normal week: making or serving, plus messages, admin, buying supplies and deliveries.

payGoal.label: What you want to take home from the business per year ($)
payGoal.how: What you need for your personal bills and savings for a year, plus what would make the work worth it.

rate.label: What an hour of your time is worth ($/hour)
rate.how: Start from your pay goal ÷ (hours a week × 48 weeks), then compare it with what you’d earn doing similar work for someone else.

replaceRate.label: What you’d pay someone else to do your work ($/hour)
replaceRate.how: What local job ads or freelancers charge for the same kind of work.

revenueMonth.label: Sales ($)
revenueMonth.how: Average of the last 3 months of sales from your bank, card reader or shop reports.
revenueMonth.group: Running costs in a typical month

laborMonth.label: Staff and contractor pay — not your own ($)
laborMonth.how: Wages and contractor payments in a normal month; 0 if it’s just you.
laborMonth.group: Running costs in a typical month

materialsMonth.label: Materials, stock and supplies ($)
materialsMonth.how: Supplier receipts or card statements for ingredients, stock, packaging and supplies, averaged over 3 months.
materialsMonth.group: Running costs in a typical month

overhead.label: Other running costs — rent, software, insurance, utilities, fees ($)
overhead.how: Rent, software, insurance, phone, utilities, platform and card fees — a monthly average from bank statements.
overhead.group: Running costs in a typical month

newMonth.label: New customers in a typical month
newMonth.how: First-time buyers in a normal month — from order history, booking records, or a rough count.

cac.label: What it costs to win one new customer — ads, samples, discounts (CAC, $)
cac.how: Marketing spend over the last 1–3 months (ads, samples, giveaways, first-order discounts) ÷ new customers in that time.

buysPerYear.label: How many times a customer buys from you per year
buysPerYear.how: Look up a few regular customers in your order history and count their purchases in the last year.

years.label: How many years a customer usually stays
years.how: How long your regulars have been buying from you; use 1 if most buy once.

ltv.label: What a typical customer spends with you over time (lifetime value, $)
ltv.placeholder: leave blank and the app works it out
ltv.how: Average sale × purchases a year × years they stay.

sell.label: What do you want to sell more of this season?
sell.placeholder: e.g. Gift boxes of our small-batch candles, and gift cards for last-minute shoppers

keywords.label: What would people search or ask about?
keywords.placeholder: e.g. candle gift ideas, gifts for coworkers under $50, best soy candles

who.label: Who are you listening for?
who.placeholder: e.g. people buying gifts for mom, office managers

competitors.label: Up to 3 competitors whose reviews are worth reading (optional)
competitors.placeholder: e.g. Joe’s Auto, Midas on Main St

gbp.label: Google Business Profile
options: Yes, and it’s up to date

services.label: Services or products you want to be found for, most profitable first
services.placeholder: e.g. brake repair, collision repair, AC service

area.label: City and the neighborhoods or suburbs you serve
area.placeholder: e.g. Decatur, GA — Oakhurst, Kirkwood, Avondale

competitors.label: Up to 3 competitors (names or websites), optional
competitors.placeholder: e.g. Joe’s Auto, Midas on Main St

goal.label: Holiday goal
goal.placeholder: e.g. 40 orders and $4,000 in sales by Dec 24

voice.label: Your brand voice
voice.placeholder: e.g. warm, a little funny, never pushy

tools.label: Tools you already use
tools.placeholder: e.g. Shopify, Square, Gmail, Instagram, Calendly, Mailchimp

chores.label: What eats your time every week?
chores.placeholder: e.g. answering the same DMs, chasing quotes, posting every day

hours.label: Hours per week you can give this

help.label: Anyone helping you?
help.placeholder: e.g. my partner on weekends, a part-time assistant
